Schloss Ernegg
Steeped in history since 1656
DISCOVER SCHLOSS ERNEGG
Our History
With a history spanning over 1,000 years, Schloss _ Ernegg was first mentioned in 979. Since 1656, the castle has been owned by the Auersperg family, who have preserved and enhanced its historic charm.
A historic Austrian castle for meaningful escapes and unique experiences
Over the centuries, Schloss Ernegg has retained its romantic and inspiring character, surviving fires and renovations while preserving its authentic historic features, frescoes, and architectural details.
A living heritage, Schloss Ernegg offers a unique setting for weddings, events, retreats, and moments of serene inspiration amidst Austria’s lush landscapes.

Testimonials
Experiences Worth Sharing
"Because of a wedding the next day, there were only a few guests, so we were allowed to explore the castle and the other rooms. All rooms are tastefully furnished, from country-house style to baroque. Bathrooms are quite new. Breakfast was plentiful, although there was no service staff — but we managed perfectly well on our own."
EXPAND
Ellen
24.08.2024 · 10/10
A wonderful experience from A to Z: the lovingly designed and carefully renovated rooms, halls, and corridors; the style of the furniture; the well-chosen artwork (a fitting painting above the bed, small drawings in the bathroom, copper engravings and old maps in the breakfast room); the piano music in the courtyard in the evening; the beautiful tiled stove that was heated just for us; the breakfast that leaves nothing to be desired; the large tree swing; the well-kept garden; the open rooms available for viewing (including a mini-museum with two complete suits of armor, a large press, forge, tools, etc.); the view; and the convenient location for various excursions.
EXPAND
Stefan
09.10.2023 - 10/10
The castle is hidden in a small wooded area and invites you to dream. The lady of thecastle is personally on site, takes care of everything, and takes the time to talk to guests.
EXPAND
Martin
10.2025 - 10/10
The entire castle is very cozy. Arrival was very pleasant, as we were well informed via WhatsApp about the key safe (our late arrival was perfectly organized). Very friendly welcome at breakfast… extensive buffet. The castle courtyard is a feast for the eyes and had background music — wonderful atmosphere! The high ceilings make the rooms very cozy.
EXPAND
Ingrid
27.07.2025 - 9/10
Romantic castle and perfect for a (short) golf holiday. Breakfast was good with a nice selection.
EXPAND
Sonja
27.08.2025 - 9/10
A wonderful experience that we will definitely repeat! The location is unique — especially for this price. The castle is hidden in a small wooded area and invites you to dream. Many rooms, such as the large hall and other chambers, can be explored. Anyone who has always wanted to move almost freely through a castle and discover many things is absolutely in the right place here. The lady of the castle is personally on site, takes care of everything, and takes the time to talk to guests. Breakfast is simple and good.
EXPAND
Martin
04.10.2025 - 10/10

About Schloss Ernegg | Historic Castle Venue in Austria
About Us
Located in the heart of Austria, Schloss Ernegg is an unspoilt, privately run castle set in a stunning 70 hectare estate comprising of a golf course and woodlands with far reaching views over the Danube valley.
‍It welcomes guests between May and October.
The Castle and estate, owned by the Auersperg family since 1656, is located in the heart of Austria and is easily accessible between Linz and Vienna.
Our hearts beat for the tranquillity, the open space, and the authentic atmosphere of this historic castle surrounded by nature.
Origins
A place that is both powerful and inspiring, as well as idyllic and romantic. Ideal for weddings and celebrations, corporate events and seminars, as well as relaxing golf and holiday stays.
Enquire now
Our History
A historic castle with a story
Schloss Ernegg was first mentioned in 979. Originally granted to the Bishop of Regensburg by Otto II, the castle has passed through centuries of noble ownership and careful stewardship.
Today, Schloss Ernegg showcases 16th-century architecture, including a trapezoidal layout, a central tower, an arcaded courtyard, and the Chapel of St. Bartholomew, lovingly restored in 2002 for private weddings.
We live through and for our guests—whether at seminars, retreats, in small groups, or during creative getaways: here there is space for new perspectives.
the person BEHIND SCHLOSS ERNEGG
GEORGINA
Georgina Auersperg Newall, a trained landscape designer and direct descendant of the Auersperg lineage, dedicated to restoring and maintaining the castle while creating a welcoming and inspiring environment for guests.
EXPAND
Our Surroundings
Schloss Ernegg is surrounded by rolling hills, quiet villages, and wide open countryside. The setting provides space, beauty, and calm in equal measure.

wikipedia.extract: Das Schloss Ernegg befindet sich in der Katastralgemeinde Ernegg der niederösterreichischen Marktgemeinde Steinakirchen am Forst. Das Schloss wird als Hotel genutzt und liegt auf der Adresse Ernegg 1.
